svg.title: HotRC HT-10A Mini Hunter control mapping
svg.desc: Left stick vertical motion is channel 3 and changes Trig. Right stick horizontal motion is channel 1 and changes Turn. Mini Hunter OLED examples show neutral, throttle, and turning values.
svg.text: Example bundled controller. Receiver intentionally omitted so the controls are easy to see.
What the robot OLED should show
Values change live while RC Mode is open.
The sign can reverse with transmitter settings.
The important check: centered = 0; movement = change.
